experiment.head: four teacher-mode logits plus one tanh continuous steering output; deterministic native eight-channel decode
experiment.loss: unweighted mode cross-entropy + Chase-only steering squared error averaged over all callbacks, with coefficient 1
experiment.callback_order: chronological within each match; fixed frozen match order; each training callback once per epoch; no balancing
experiment.hidden_state: reset only at match boundaries; detach gradient every training chunk without changing hidden-state values
experiment.checkpoint_selection: minimum teacher-forced validation loss; no test access for selection
experiment.evaluation_device: CPU, one thread, same selected checkpoint for both conditions
experiment.exact_action_agreement: all eight decoded native channels equal frozen float32 analog and uint8 button targets exactly; no tolerance
experiment.additional_tolerant_action_agreement: all buttons exact and all analog absolute errors <= 0.000001; reported separately
experiment.test_policy: only after both models selected; one final evaluation suite per selected model, both conditions; no test tuning
experiment.student_forced_scope: replace only prior-mode one-hot and prior steering in a copied recorded input; preserve all other recorded features and dt; not closed-loop gameplay

A.state_note: GRU hidden values carried between chronological chunks; gradients detached. Hidden values computed under preceding chunk weights are carried after optimizer updates; never reset at phases.

B.state_note: GRU hidden values carried between chronological chunks; gradients detached. Hidden values computed under preceding chunk weights are carried after optimizer updates; never reset at phases.

limitations: Splits are match-disjoint, NOT fully opponent/session-disjoint: human_a spans train/validation/test. human_b has two train matches only (v10_004 and v10_006), sharing human_b_v10_session_01. human_c has one test match (v10_005). No records or split assignments were changed.
Opponent identities were declared by the user; pilot play-session identities were not separately recorded and remain unknown.
Coverage targets are provisional heuristics, not proof of recurrent learning or generalization; natural collection does not guarantee extreme states or long pending-sequence interruptions.
Counts describe actual processed RLBot callbacks, not lossless network delivery or undelivered physics ticks.
Hidden teacher sequence state is diagnostic only and excluded from the unchanged 18D observations.

This is an immutable hash-identified reference artifact, not an OS write lock on the original files. Referenced files must remain available and pass verification; changes require a new dataset version.
Historical code hashes are retained from collection metadata. Current code snapshots are labeled separately and do not claim to reconstruct unavailable historical revisions.
One seed and bounded fixed architecture/loss comparison, not a hyperparameter sweep or generalization guarantee.
Student-forced diagnostic uses recorded physics/prediction, not physics resulting from student controls; not closed-loop evaluation.
Final exact native agreement is with frozen float32 analog targets; raw double-precision controller values remain preserved in raw records.
Private sequence labels used only for retrospective metric subsets, never model inputs, fitting weights or selection.
Both modes use identical CPU evaluation. Training on GPU and CPU evaluation may have small floating-point differences.

review_interpretation.source: Already-saved final evaluation only; no repeated test access or fitting
review_interpretation.conclusion: Neither model demonstrates adequate offline autoregressive robustness for deployment
review_interpretation.teacher_forced_tradeoff: GRU lower loss and better Front-dodge/boundary mode accuracy; MLP lower steering MAE and slightly higher pure Jump-mode accuracy
review_interpretation.student_forced_failure: Large mode/throttle/steering degradation; GRU test Chase-mode accuracy 0%; jump-button recall MLP 0%, GRU about 1.8%
review_interpretation.mechanism: Consistent with teacher-context dependence; specific mechanism not established
review_interpretation.long_gap_scope: Two validation callbacks >100 ms; zero in test
review_interpretation.missing_ball_scope: Neutral output correct; learned pending sequence memory not established
